name: Launch readiness
goal: Harden, instrument, and package the app for store submission.

tasks.title: Add end-to-end Maestro flows
acceptance: E2E covers onboarding, text chat, guide reading, and emergency
Flows use stable accessibility IDs, not brittle text selectors
Docs explain how to run them locally and in CI
The flows are committed and parse as valid YAML

tasks.title: Run and document an accessibility audit
acceptance: Every screen has labels, roles, and focus order checked
Dynamic type and reduced motion are verified
Contrast is checked for all text
Findings and fixes are documented

tasks.title: Run a performance and bundle audit
acceptance: Bundle size and startup time are measured
3D/Lottie assets are lazy-loaded or removed if unused
Long-list performance is verified
Regressions and follow-ups are documented

tasks.title: Add Sentry and production logging
acceptance: Sentry initializes only when a DSN is configured
Message bodies and health data are never sent
Non-fatal errors are reported with context
The app still runs without a DSN

tasks.title: Prepare store metadata and assets
acceptance: App name, subtitle, description, keywords, and category are drafted
Privacy labels and data-safety answers are drafted
Required icon and screenshot sizes are listed
No unsupported medical claims appear in copy

tasks.title: Final legal and privacy review
acceptance: A human has reviewed disclaimer, privacy policy, terms, and store copy
Emergency and limitation-of-liability language is approved
The review is recorded in docs/legal/REVIEW.md
No claims imply diagnosis or treatment

tasks.title: Create a production EAS build
acceptance: Production build profile is reviewed
The build runs on a clean checkout
Version and build numbers are set
The build artifact is linked in docs/store/build.md

tasks.title: Submit to app stores
acceptance: A human submits the production build
Store review notes and demo credentials are provided
Submission status is recorded
Rollback plan is documented

tasks.title: Phase 5 launch review
acceptance: A human has run the full E2E suite
Crash-free and latency targets are met or accepted
Store submission is approved
The reviewer signs off in loop/ESCALATIONS.md
